<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_Dismissal" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/dismissal">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Dismissal" name="Dismissal"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Dismissal">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_MSPN" name="MSPN" processRef="Process_MSPN"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_MSPO" name="MSPO" processRef="Process_MSPO"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Dismissal" name="Dismissal" sourceRef="Task_SendDismissal" targetRef="StartEvent_ReceiveDismissal" messageRef="Message_Dismissal"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_MSPN" name="MSPN process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_MSPN" name="Start">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MSPN_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendDismissal" name="Send dismissal">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MSPN_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MSPN_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_DismissalSent" name="Dismissal sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MSPN_2</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MSPN_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_MSPN" targetRef="Task_SendDismissal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MSPN_2" sourceRef="Task_SendDismissal" targetRef="EndEvent_DismissalSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_MSPO" name="MSPO process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ReceiveDismissal" name="Dismissal received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MSPO_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Dismissal" messageRef="Message_Dismissal"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewDismissal" name="Review dismissal">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MSPO_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MSPO_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DismissalDecision_Split" name="Decision">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MSPO_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MSPO_3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MSPO_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RejectDismissal" name="Reject dismissal">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MSPO_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MSPO_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfirmDismissal" name="Confirm dismissal">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MSPO_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MSPO_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_DismissalRejected" name="Dismissal of MSPN rejected">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MSPO_5</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_DismissalConfirmed" name="Dismissal of MSPN confirmed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MSPO_6</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MSPO_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_ReceiveDismissal" targetRef="Task_ReviewDismissal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MSPO_2" sourceRef="Task_ReviewDismissal" targetRef="Gateway_DismissalDecision_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MSPO_3" sourceRef="Gateway_DismissalDecision_Split" targetRef="Task_RejectDismissal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MSPO_4" sourceRef="Gateway_DismissalDecision_Split" targetRef="Task_ConfirmDismissal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MSPO_5" sourceRef="Task_RejectDismissal" targetRef="EndEvent_DismissalRejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MSPO_6" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmDismissal" targetRef="EndEvent_DismissalConfirmed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
